statement: The function returns a result r, and r = max { (min(nums[i], nums[i+1], ..., nums[j])) * (j - i + 1) : 0 <= i <= k <= j < len(nums) }, where k in this formula denotes the integer value of the Lean parameter k.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; for every t with 0 <= t < len(nums), 1 <= nums[t] <= 20000; and 0 <= k < len(nums), where k is interpreted by its integer value.

preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; for every t with 0 <= t < len(nums), 1 <= nums[t] <= 20000; and 0 <= k < len(nums), where k is interpreted by its integer value.

statement: Let n = len(nums). Let rev be the slice of length n with rev[t] = nums[n - 1 - t] for every t with 0 <= t < n, and let k' = n - 1 - k, using the integer value of k. Whenever maximum_score(nums, k) returns a result r, the call maximum_score(rev, k') returns the same result r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; for every t with 0 <= t < len(nums), 1 <= nums[t] <= 20000; and 0 <= k < len(nums), where k is interpreted by its integer value.

statement: Let scaled be the slice of length len(nums) with scaled[t] = c * nums[t] for every t with 0 <= t < len(nums). Whenever maximum_score(nums, k) returns a result r, the call maximum_score(scaled, k) returns c * r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; for every t with 0 <= t < len(nums), 1 <= nums[t] <= 20000; 0 <= k < len(nums); c is an integer with c >= 1; and c * nums[t] <= 20000 for every t with 0 <= t < len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = max { nums[j] * (j + 1) : k <= j < len(nums) }.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 100000; for every t with 0 <= t < len(nums), 1 <= nums[t] <= 20000; 0 <= k < len(nums); and for every t with 0 <= t < len(nums) - 1, nums[t] >= nums[t+1].
